cards.ex: She's hellbent on getting into Harvard, no matter how much it costs.
cards.exUz: U Harvardga kirishga qattiq bel bog'lagan, qancha turishidan qat'i nazar.
cards.uzDef: Nimaga erishish uchun juda qattiq qaror qilgan bo'lmoq, hech narsaga qaramay

cards.ex: He harbored ambitions of becoming a famous novelist, though he never spoke of it.
cards.exUz: U mashhur yozuvchi bo'lish maqsadini ichiga yashirgan, garchi bu haqda hech qachon gapirmagan bo'lsa ham.
cards.uzDef: Yashirincha yoki ochiqchasiga katta maqsadlarga ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The new project was a real shot in the arm for the whole team.
cards.exUz: Yangi loyiha butun jamoa uchun haqiqiy yangicha turtki bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi turtki beradigan, ishtiyoqni oshiradigan narsa.

cards.ex: If you want to achieve great things, you need to set your sights high.
cards.exUz: Agar buyuk narsalarga erishmoqchi bo'lsangiz, maqsadlaringizni baland qo'yishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zingiz uchun juda yuqori va qiyin maqsadlar qo'ymoq.

cards.ex: Winning the lottery is a long shot, but people still buy tickets.
cards.exUz: Lotereyada yutish - umidsiz urinish, lekin odamlar hali ham chipta sotib olishadi.
cards.uzDef: Amalga oshish ehtimoli juda kam bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: When they offered me the job in Rome, I jumped at the opportunity.
cards.exUz: Menga Rimda ish taklif qilishganida, men imkoniyatni qo'ldan bermadim.
cards.uzDef: Imkoniyat paydo bo'lganda, unga tez va ishtiyoq bilan rozi bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: We'll leave no stone unturned in our search for the missing child.
cards.exUz: Yo'qolgan bolani qidirishda biz hamma chorani ko'ramiz.
cards.uzDef: Nimaga erishish uchun barcha imkoniyatlardan foydalanmoq, barcha usullarni sinab ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: She wanted to make her mark on the world through her art.
cards.exUz: U san'ati orqali dunyoda iz qoldirishni xohladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror sohada katta ta'sir ko'rsatmoq yoki muvaffaqiyatga erishmoq.

cards.ex: The company is grasping at straws to avoid bankruptcy.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya bankrotlikdan qochish uchun somonga yopishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat umidsiz bo'lganda, oxirgi imkoniyatga yopishmoq.

cards.ex: The team is riding high after winning the championship.
cards.exUz: Jamoa chempionatda g'alaba qozonganidan keyin muvaffaqiyat qozonmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Katta muvaffaqiyatlarga erishayotgan, omadi chopayotgan vaqt.

cards.ex: I'm not sure I can fix it, but I'll have a crack at it.
cards.exUz: Buni tuzata olishimga amin emasman, lekin urinib ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qilishga harakat qilib ko'rmoq, urinib ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: Their plans for a lunar colony are just a pie in the sky.
cards.exUz: Ularning oy koloniyasi haqidagi rejalari shunchaki amalga oshmas orzu.
cards.uzDef: Amalga oshishi dargumon bo'lgan orzu yoki reja.

cards.ex: She's a talented young actress; she's definitely going places.
cards.exUz: U iste'dodli yosh aktrisa; u albatta omadga erishadi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda katta muvaffaqiyatlarga erishish ehtimoli yuqori bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: With hard work and dedication, you can attain your goals.
cards.exUz: Mehnat va fidoyilik bilan o'z maqsadlaringizga erishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: O'z oldiga qo'ygan maqsadlariga erishmoq.

cards.ex: I suspect he has a hidden agenda for supporting this project.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, uning ushbu loyihani qo'llab-quvvatlashidan yashirin maqsadi bor.
cards.uzDef: Ochiq aytilmaydigan, yashirincha maqsad.

cards.ex: He hopes to leave his mark on the world through his inventions.
cards.exUz: U o'z ixtirolari orqali dunyoda iz qoldirishga umid qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror sohada katta ta'sir ko'rsatmoq yoki muvaffaqiyatga erishmoq.

cards.ex: He's always been on the make, looking for ways to get ahead.
cards.exUz: U har doim muvaffaqiyatga intilib, oldinga siljish yo'llarini qidirgan.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga foyda keltiradigan imkoniyatlarni qidirib, muvaffaqiyatga erishishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: I can't worry about that right now, I have bigger fish to fry.
cards.exUz: Men hozir bu haqda qayg'ura olmayman, meni muhimroq ishlarim bor.
cards.uzDef: Hozirgi vaziyatdan muhimroq yoki shoshilinchroq ishlar bor.

cards.ex: The company struck gold with its new invention.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yangi ixtirosi bilan birdaniga omadi chopdi.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga katta muvaffaqiyatga yoki boylikka erishmoq.

cards.ex: He felt pressured to live up to his parents' expectations.
cards.exUz: U ota-onasining umidlarini oqlash uchun bosim his qildi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarning kutgan natijalarini ko'rsatmoq.

cards.ex: She decided to quit her job and pursue her passion for photography.
cards.exUz: U ishini tashlab, fotografiyaga bo'lgan ishtiyoqini quvishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Sevgan va qiziqqan narsangiz bilan shug'ullanmoq.

cards.ex: Even though it's tough, keep your eyes on the prize and you'll succeed.
cards.exUz: Garchi qiyin bo'lsa ham, maqsadingizga diqqatni jamlang va siz muvaffaqiyatga erishasiz.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga diqqatni jamlab, chalg'imasdan harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: She decided to throw her hat in the ring for the position of manager.
cards.exUz: U menejer lavozimiga o'z nomzodini qo'yishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Tanlovda qatnashish uchun nomzodini qo'ymoq.

cards.ex: A promotion might be on the cards if you continue to work hard.
cards.exUz: Agar siz qattiq mehnat qilishda davom etsangiz, lavozim ko'tarilishi ehtimoliy bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ehtimoliy bo'lmoq, sodir bo'lishi kutilmoq.

cards.ex: I didn't want to do it, but I had to bite the bullet and tell him the truth.
cards.exUz: Men buni qilishni xohlamadim, lekin chidamga kelib, unga haqiqatni aytishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki yoqimsiz vaziyatni sabr bilan kutib olmoq.

cards.ex: Trying to change the company's culture is an uphill battle.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning madaniyatini o'zgartirish - qiyin kurash.
cards.uzDef: Ehtimoli kam bo'lgan, juda qiyin bo'lgan kurash.

cards.ex: Getting the project finished by Friday is a tall order, but we'll try.
cards.exUz: Loyiha juma kuniga qadar tugatish qiyin vazifa, lekin harakat qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Bajarish juda qiyin bo'lgan ish yoki vazifa.

cards.ex: The CEO decided to throw his weight behind the new marketing campaign.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktor yangi marketing kampaniyasini qo'llab-quvvatlashga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishini yoki narsani qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun kuch va ta'siringizni ishlatish.

cards.ex: She always goes the extra mile for her clients, ensuring they're completely satisfied.
cards.exUz: U har doim mijozlari uchun jon kuydiradi va ularning to'liq qoniqishini ta'minlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Kerak bo'lganidan ko'proq harakat qilish, alohida g'ayrat ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: It's time to grasp the nettle and deal with these financial problems.
cards.exUz: Endi qiyinchilikka qarshi chiqish va bu moliyaviy muammolarni hal qilish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin, noxush vaziyatni jasorat bilan hal qilishga kirishish.
